unsignedExtensionsRiskDetails.en:
Unsigned extensions bypass Mozilla's safety review process. Malicious extensions can:

• Read and modify everything you see on any website
• Steal passwords, banking details, and personal data
• Monitor your browsing activity silently
• Install additional malware on your device
unsignedExtensionsRiskDetails.zh:
未签名扩展会绕过 Mozilla 的安全审核流程。恶意扩展可能：

• 读取和修改你在任何网站上看到的所有内容
• 窃取密码、银行信息和个人数据
• 在不知情的情况下监控你的浏览活动
• 在设备上安装其他恶意软件
